correctness.rationale: The central-involution argument exhausts all possible ramification because every nontrivial subgroup of Q8 contains the center. The six fixed points are computed exactly on X=0, their three order-four stabilizers are identified explicitly, and tame Riemann--Hurwitz gives quotient genus one. The accompanying exact symbolic checker verifies the matrix relations, polynomial invariance, fixed-point equations, and arithmetic.
